asteroid.title: Asteroids — Arcade game and custom 2D engine
asteroid.desc: Asteroids is an arcade game developed in C++20 and SFML 3.0.0, built on a custom 2D engine. The project focuses on reusable systems: actors and components, level management, action-based input, collisions, animation and UI. Two game modes share the architecture: a classic wave-based mode with upgrades and a timed score challenge.

columns.content: The Engine class computes delta time and updates the active level. Each Level owns managers for actors, rendering, collisions and audio.

AActor is the base for world objects. Specialized UComponent instances handle movement, shooting, health, collision, animation and rendering. Actors can own children with relative transforms. Lifecycle stages include BeginPlay, Tick and BeginDestroy. Relevant files: Actor.h, Actor.cpp, Component.h and ShootComponent.cpp.

ActionMap binds keyboard, mouse and controller events to callbacks. UCollisionComponent defines channels and collision responses, while CollisionManager dispatches enter, stay and exit events. Classic mode uses waves and upgrades; Chrono mode features a countdown, enemy spawns and score tracking.

despair.title: Despair
despair.desc: Despair is a stealth game developed in Unreal Engine 5.4.4 by a team of 20, including six programmers, as a first-year final project at Objectif 3D. My responsibilities covered graphics settings, user interface and save-game systems.
